title: Chapter8
description: Finnish vocabulary: health, the body, illness, the doctor and verbs

questions.question: To cause
questions.explanation: 'Aiheuttaa' (type 1 verb) means to cause; 'aiheutan' is 'I cause'.

questions.question: Substance / Material
questions.explanation: 'Aine' means substance or material; its genitive is 'aineen'.

questions.question: To sneeze
questions.explanation: 'Aivastaa' (type 1 verb) means to sneeze; 'aivastan' is 'I sneeze'.
questions.exampletranslate: I sneeze when I have the flu.

questions.question: Point in time / Moment
questions.explanation: 'Ajankohta' means point in time or moment; its genitive is 'ajankohdan'.
questions.exampletranslate: What is a suitable time for you?

questions.question: Appointment (reservation)
questions.explanation: 'Ajanvaraus' means an appointment or time reservation; its genitive is 'ajanvarauksen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I make an appointment with the doctor.

questions.question: Pack (e.g. cigarette pack)
questions.explanation: 'Aski' means a small box or pack (e.g. a cigarette pack).
questions.exampletranslate: He bought a pack of cigarettes.

questions.question: Assistant
questions.exampletranslate: The doctor's assistant helps the patients.

questions.question: To have time / make it
questions.explanation: 'Ehtiä' (type 1 verb) means to have time or make it in time; 'ehdin' is 'I have time'.
questions.exampletranslate: I make it to the doctor in time.

questions.question: Separately
questions.exampletranslate: I pay for the medicines separately.

questions.question: To ease / relieve
questions.explanation: 'Helpottaa' (type 1 verb) means to ease or relieve; 'helpotan' is 'I ease'.

questions.question: Breath / Life
questions.explanation: 'Henki' means breath, life or spirit; its genitive is 'hengen'.

questions.question: Pea soup
questions.explanation: 'Hernekeitto' means pea soup; its genitive is 'hernekeiton'.
questions.exampletranslate: On Thursday we eat pea soup.

questions.question: Guardian
questions.exampletranslate: The child's guardian signs the permission.

questions.question: Feeling unwell / Malaise
questions.explanation: 'Huono olo' means feeling unwell or malaise.

questions.question: Emergency / Distress
questions.explanation: 'Hätä' means emergency or distress; its genitive is 'hädän'.

questions.question: Emergency (case)
questions.explanation: 'Hätätapaus' means an emergency (case); its genitive is 'hätätapauksen'.

questions.question: Information / Info desk
questions.explanation: 'Info' means information or the information desk.
questions.exampletranslate: Ask the info desk for more.

questions.question: To register / check in
questions.explanation: 'Ilmoittautua' (type 1 verb) means to register or check in; 'ilmoittaudun' is 'I register'.
questions.exampletranslate: I check in at the reception.

questions.question: IT support
questions.explanation: 'IT-tuki' means IT support; its genitive is 'IT-tuen'.

questions.question: To have the strength / manage
questions.explanation: 'Jaksaa' (type 1 verb) means to have the strength or energy to manage; 'jaksan' is 'I manage'.
questions.exampletranslate: I don't have the strength to get out of bed.

questions.question: Leg / Foot
questions.explanation: 'Jalka' means leg or foot; its genitive is 'jalan'.

questions.question: To continue
questions.explanation: 'Jatkua' (type 1 verb) means to continue or go on; 'se jatkuu' means 'it continues'.

questions.question: To queue
questions.explanation: 'Jonottaa' (type 1 verb) means to queue; 'jonotan' is 'I queue'.

questions.question: Drink (something to drink)
questions.exampletranslate: Would you like something to drink?

questions.question: Ice
questions.exampletranslate: I put ice on the wound.

questions.question: Ice cube
questions.exampletranslate: I put an ice cube in the water.

questions.question: To fall (down)
questions.explanation: 'Kaatua' (type 1 verb) means to fall down or tip over; 'kaadun' is 'I fall'.
questions.exampletranslate: I fell on the icy road.

questions.question: Pale
questions.exampletranslate: You are pale, are you sick?

questions.question: Point / Spot (noun)
questions.explanation: 'Kohta' as a noun means a point or spot; its genitive is 'kohdan'.

questions.question: To touch / concern
questions.explanation: 'Koskea' (type 1 verb) means to touch or concern; 'se koskee' means 'it touches/concerns'.

questions.question: To transport / drive
questions.explanation: 'Kuljettaa' (type 1 verb) means to transport or drive; 'kuljetan' is 'I transport'.
questions.exampletranslate: The ambulance transports the patient to the hospital.

questions.question: Sore throat
questions.explanation: 'Kurkkukipu' means sore throat; its genitive is 'kurkkukivun'.

questions.question: To hear
questions.explanation: 'Kuulla' (type 1 verb) means to hear; 'kuulen' is 'I hear'.

questions.question: Side (of the body)
questions.explanation: 'Kylki' means side (of the body); its genitive is 'kyljen'.

questions.question: Patient (adjective)
questions.explanation: 'Kärsivällinen' means patient (as in calm, enduring); its genitive is 'kärsivällisen'.

questions.question: Hand
questions.exampletranslate: I wash my hands with soap.

questions.question: Corridor / Aisle
questions.exampletranslate: The waiting room is at the end of the corridor.

questions.question: Band-aid / Plaster
questions.exampletranslate: I put a band-aid on the wound.

questions.question: To rest
questions.explanation: 'Levätä' (type 4 verb) means to rest; 'lepään' is 'I rest'.

questions.question: Muscle
questions.exampletranslate: The muscle is sore after exercise.

questions.question: To be related to / join
questions.explanation: 'Liittyä' (type 1 verb) means to be related to or join; 'liityn' is 'I join' (used with 'mihin').
questions.exampletranslate: This symptom is related to the flu.

questions.question: Additional information
questions.explanation: 'Lisätieto' means additional information; its genitive is 'lisätiedon'.
questions.exampletranslate: I need additional information about the medicine.

questions.question: Lunch time
questions.explanation: 'Lounasaika' means lunch time; its genitive is 'lounasajan'.
questions.exampletranslate: The reception is closed at lunch time.

questions.question: Unauthorized / Forbidden
questions.explanation: 'Luvaton' means unauthorized or forbidden; its genitive is 'luvattoman'.

questions.question: Medicine
questions.exampletranslate: I take medicine for the pain.

questions.question: Medication (treatment)
questions.explanation: 'Lääkitys' means medication or medical treatment; its genitive is 'lääkityksen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The doctor starts a new medication.

questions.question: Doctor
questions.exampletranslate: I go to the doctor tomorrow.

questions.question: To lie down
questions.explanation: 'Maata' (type 4 verb) means to lie down; 'makaan' is 'I lie down'.
questions.exampletranslate: I lie in bed all day.

questions.question: According to
questions.explanation: 'Mukaan' means according to (e.g. 'jonkin mukaan' = according to something).
questions.exampletranslate: According to the doctor it is the flu.

questions.question: To advise
questions.explanation: 'Neuvoa' (type 1 verb) means to advise; 'neuvon' is 'I advise'.

questions.question: To blow one's nose
questions.explanation: 'Niistää' (type 1 verb) means to blow one's nose; 'niistän' is 'I blow my nose'.
questions.exampletranslate: I blow my nose into a tissue.

questions.question: Neck / Nape
questions.explanation: 'Niska' means neck or nape (the back of the neck).

questions.question: To lift / raise
questions.explanation: 'Nostaa' (type 1 verb) means to lift or raise; 'nostan' is 'I lift'.

questions.question: Runny nose / Nasal cold
questions.explanation: 'Nuha' means a runny nose or nasal cold.

questions.question: To feel nauseous
questions.explanation: 'Oksettaa' (type 1 verb) means to feel nauseous; 'minua oksettaa' means 'I feel nauseous'.

questions.question: Feeling / State (of being)
questions.explanation: 'Olo' means feeling or state of being; its genitive is 'olon'.

questions.question: To receive / admit (a patient)
questions.explanation: 'Ottaa vastaan' means to receive or admit; the doctor 'ottaa potilaan vastaan' (sees the patient).
questions.exampletranslate: The doctor sees patients in the morning.

questions.question: Freezer bag
questions.exampletranslate: I put the ice in a freezer bag.

questions.question: Service
questions.exampletranslate: The health station's service is good.

questions.question: To cancel
questions.explanation: 'Peruuttaa' (type 1 verb) means to cancel; 'peruutan' is 'I cancel'.

questions.question: To inject / sting / put
questions.explanation: 'Pistää' (type 1 verb) means to inject, sting or put; 'pistän' is 'I inject/put'.

questions.question: Absence
questions.exampletranslate: Report your absence to the workplace.

questions.question: Stairs
questions.explanation: 'Portaat' means stairs (a plural word); its genitive is 'portaiden'.

questions.question: Patient (noun)
questions.explanation: 'Potilas' means patient (a sick person); its genitive is 'potilaan'.
questions.exampletranslate: The patient waits in the corridor.

questions.question: To clean
questions.explanation: 'Puhdistaa' (type 1 verb) means to clean; 'puhdistan' is 'I clean'.
questions.exampletranslate: I clean the wound with water.

questions.question: After / in (a period of time)
questions.explanation: 'Päästä' is used in time expressions like 'tunnin päästä' meaning 'in an hour'.

questions.question: Building
questions.exampletranslate: The health centre is a big building.

questions.question: Greasy / Fatty
questions.explanation: 'Rasvainen' means greasy or fatty; its genitive is 'rasvaisen'.

questions.question: Diarrhea
questions.exampletranslate: With a stomach bug there is often diarrhea.

questions.question: Body part
questions.exampletranslate: The hand is a body part.

questions.question: Soap
questions.exampletranslate: I wash my hands with soap.

questions.question: To be ill (with a disease)
questions.explanation: 'Sairastaa' (type 1 verb) means to be ill with a disease; 'sairastan' is 'I am ill (with)'.
questions.exampletranslate: I have (am ill with) the flu.

questions.question: Sick leave
questions.exampletranslate: I am on sick leave for a week.

questions.question: To hurt
questions.explanation: 'Sattua' (type 1 verb) means to hurt; 'mihin sattuu' means 'where does it hurt'.

questions.question: Explanation / Report
questions.explanation: 'Selvitys' means an explanation or report; its genitive is 'selvityksen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I need a report about the illness.

questions.question: To store / keep
questions.explanation: 'Säilyttää' (type 1 verb) means to store or keep; 'säilytän' is 'I store'.
questions.exampletranslate: I keep the medicines in the cupboard.

questions.question: Ache / Pain
questions.explanation: 'Särky' means ache or pain; its genitive is 'säryn'.

questions.question: Painkiller
questions.exampletranslate: I take a painkiller for the headache.

questions.question: Tablet / Pill
questions.explanation: 'Tabletti' means tablet or pill; its genitive is 'tabletin'.
questions.exampletranslate: I take one tablet a day.

questions.question: Taxi
questions.exampletranslate: I take a taxi to the hospital.

questions.question: To inspect / examine
questions.explanation: 'Tarkastaa' (type 1 verb) means to inspect; 'tarkastan' is 'I inspect'.

questions.question: To verify / check
questions.explanation: 'Tarkistaa' (type 1 verb) means to verify or check; 'tarkistan' is 'I check'.

questions.question: To catch (illness) / grab
questions.explanation: 'Tarttua' (type 1 verb) means to catch (e.g. an illness), grab or stick; 'tartun' is 'I grab' (used with 'mihin').

questions.question: Public health nurse
questions.exampletranslate: The public health nurse measures the blood pressure.

questions.question: Health station
questions.exampletranslate: I go to the health station.

questions.question: Health centre
questions.explanation: 'Terveyskeskus' means health centre; its genitive is 'terveyskeskuksen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The health centre is open on weekdays.

questions.question: Office
questions.exampletranslate: The office is on the second floor.

questions.question: To prevent / ward off
questions.explanation: 'Torjua' (type 1 verb) means to prevent or ward off; 'torjun' is 'I prevent'.

questions.question: Infection / Inflammation
questions.explanation: 'Tulehdus' means infection or inflammation; its genitive is 'tulehduksen'.

questions.question: Spicy / Fiery
questions.explanation: 'Tulinen' means spicy or fiery; its genitive is 'tulisen'.

questions.question: To feel / palpate
questions.explanation: 'Tunnustella' (type 3 verb) means to feel or palpate; 'tunnustelen' is 'I feel' (takes a partitive object).

questions.question: To feel (like)
questions.explanation: 'Tuntua' (type 1 verb) means to feel (like); 'se tuntuu' means 'it feels' (used with 'miltä').

questions.question: To examine / research
questions.explanation: 'Tutkia' (type 1 verb) means to examine or research; 'tutkin' is 'I examine'.

questions.question: Workplace
questions.exampletranslate: I report the illness to the workplace.

questions.question: Danger
questions.exampletranslate: There is no danger to life.

questions.question: Unfortunately
questions.exampletranslate: Unfortunately the time is already booked.

questions.question: Free / Available
questions.explanation: 'Vapaa' means free or available; its genitive is 'vapaan'.
questions.exampletranslate: Does the doctor have a free time slot?

questions.question: Probably / Surely
questions.exampletranslate: It is probably just the flu.

questions.question: Stomach bug / illness
questions.explanation: 'Vatsatauti' means a stomach bug or illness; its genitive is 'vatsataudin'.

questions.question: Blood test
questions.explanation: 'Verikoe' means blood test; its genitive is 'verikokeen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I have a blood test tomorrow.

questions.question: Cream / Ointment
questions.explanation: 'Voide' means cream or ointment; its genitive is 'voiteen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I apply ointment to the wound.

questions.question: To bleed / leak / flow
questions.explanation: 'Vuotaa' (type 1 verb) means to bleed, leak or flow; 'vuodan' is 'I bleed/leak'.

questions.question: To make tired
questions.explanation: 'Väsyttää' (type 1 verb) means to make tired; 'minua väsyttää' means 'I feel tired'.

questions.question: General / Common
questions.explanation: 'Yleinen' means general or common; its genitive is 'yleisen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The flu is a common illness.
